name: Traditional Pie Crust
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Add the lard, and cut it into the dry mixture.
Gently mix in just enough water to make a stiff dough.
Roll out the dough in a cool place, and use in your recipe.

culture.text: This is the traditional pie crust. To ensure a flakey crust (considered desirable), you need to use lard and you need to keep the lard from melting. It's best to use a cold stone rolling pin and surface, and to generally keep everything in the refrigerator until used.
